# agentops_grader_config (Resource)

A grader configuration: has a grader agent automatically score a sample of another agent's runs for quality.

**Deprecated:** the underlying API has been removed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agentops_grader_config" "prod_quality" {
  target_agent_id = "agent_01hxyz"
  grader_agent_id = "agent_grader_01"
  sample_rate     = 25
  guidelines      = "Penalize hallucinated remediation steps; reward citing the runbook."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grader_agent_id` (String)
- `target_agent_id` (String)

### Optional

- `guidelines` (String)
- `sample_rate` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `runs_seen` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Grader configs are imported by their id.
terraform import agentops_grader_config.prod_quality grd_01hxyz
```
